tick.description: Each minute, replace this module's exterior illuminance contribution. While power is off, keep actual_beam_state off, keep actual_illumination at zero, and contribute zero illuminance while preserving all driver requests. While powered, determine ambient exterior illuminance by subtracting this module's previous absolute contribution from aggregate exterior illuminance, with a minimum ambient value of zero. Off mode provides no front-light illumination. Parking mode sets actual_beam_state to parking and contributes 100 lux. Headlights mode sets actual_beam_state to the requested low or high beam and contributes 800 or 1600 lux respectively. In auto mode, activate the requested beam when ambient illuminance is at most 200 lux and set the beam state to off when ambient illuminance is at least 1000 lux. Between 201 and 999 lux, preserve activation only when the previous actual_beam_state was low or high, applying the current beam request; treat previous off or parking state as inactive and set actual_beam_state to off. While powered, add 100 lux for hazards, otherwise 50 lux for an active directional signal. Store the emitted total in actual_illumination so later automatic-lighting decisions can exclude this module's own output.

If the tailgate is closed and locked, the action is rejected and all state remains unchanged. Otherwise, including when it is already ajar, door_state is set to ajar and closure_feedback is set to false atomically; the lock state is unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

error_codes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: A closed, locked tailgate cannot be set ajar. Unlock it before moving it away from the closed position.

meta.name: TrunkDoor
meta.description: Trunk door that inherits Door locking, unlocking, and door-state queries. Represents the door connection between trunk and exterior; opening and closing affect exchange between the trunk Space and the outside.

meta.name: CoolingHeatingCarRefrigerator
meta.description: Vehicle refrigerator with cooling and heating. Adds a heating mode and target temperature ranges specific to each mode.

kwargs.name: mode
kwargs.description: Selected refrigerator temperature-control mode.

kwargs.name: target_temperature
kwargs.description: Requested compartment temperature. Valid targets are 0 through 15 degrees Celsius in cooling mode and 35 through 50 degrees Celsius in heating mode.

kwargs.name: internal_temperature
kwargs.description: Current temperature inside the refrigerator compartment. This value is separate from cabin temperature and is updated by the cooling or heating temperature-control process.

kwargs.name: operating_state
kwargs.description: Temperature-control activity recorded by the most recent minute update. It is set to idle when the device is unpowered.

get_mode.name: get_mode
get_mode.description: Return the selected cooling or heating mode. Requires power on.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.mode: Selected refrigerator mode: cooling or heating. (type=string)

error_codes.POWER_OFF: The refrigerator must be powered on.

set_mode.name: set_mode
set_mode.description: Select cooling or heating mode. Requires power on. When the selected mode differs from the current mode, target_temperature is reset to 4 degrees Celsius for cooling or 40 degrees Celsius for heating so the resulting configuration is valid. Selecting the current mode leaves the existing target unchanged. Invalid input or an off power state leaves all properties unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

error_codes.POWER_OFF: The refrigerator must be powered on.
error_codes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Mode must be cooling or heating.

set_target_temperature.name: set_target_temperature
set_target_temperature.description: Set the target temperature for the selected mode. Cooling mode accepts integers from 0 through 15 degrees Celsius; heating mode accepts integers from 35 through 50 degrees Celsius. Invalid input, a target outside the selected mode's range, or an off power state leaves all properties unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

error_codes.POWER_OFF: The refrigerator must be powered on.
error_codes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Target temperature must be an integer from 0 through 15 degrees Celsius in cooling mode or from 35 through 50 degrees Celsius in heating mode.

get_operating_state.name: get_operating_state
get_operating_state.description: Return whether the refrigerator was idle, cooling, or heating at the most recent minute update. Requires power on.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.operating_state: Most recently evaluated activity: idle, cooling, or heating. (type=string)

error_codes.POWER_OFF: The refrigerator must be powered on.

tick.description: Each minute while powered in cooling mode, lower internal_temperature toward target_temperature by at most 1 degree Celsius without heating; report cooling when a decrease occurs and idle when already at or below the target. Each minute while powered in heating mode, raise internal_temperature toward target_temperature by at most 1 degree Celsius without cooling; report heating when an increase occurs and idle when already at or above the target. Never overshoot the target. While unpowered, leave internal_temperature unchanged and report idle.

effect_properties.name: power
effect_properties.description: Determines whether temperature control may run.

effect_properties.name: mode
effect_properties.description: Determines whether the device may cool or heat.

effect_properties.name: target_temperature
effect_properties.description: Mode-compatible compartment temperature approached by active control.

effect_properties.name: internal_temperature
effect_properties.description: Current compartment temperature used to determine temperature-control progress.

effect_properties.name: operating_state
effect_properties.description: Activity state updated by each minute evaluation to idle, cooling, or heating.

meta.name: DynamicAmbientLight
meta.description: Dynamic ambient light. Adds selecting, starting, and stopping local dynamic lighting effects and querying the current effect state. Dynamic effects and static color mode are mutually exclusive.

kwargs.name: effect
kwargs.description: Selected local dynamic lighting effect. Selection persists when the effect is stopped or the light is powered off.

kwargs.name: effect_state
kwargs.description: Current dynamic effect state. Stopped means the light uses its inherited static color setting; running means the selected dynamic effect is active while powered.

set_color.name: set_color
set_color.description: Set the static color using the fixed 24-bit sRGB hexadecimal format #RRGGBB and stop any running dynamic effect. Requires the ambient light to be powered on. Invalid input or a failed power precondition leaves all state unchanged.

value.name: value
value.description: Desired static 24-bit sRGB color in #RRGGBB format.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

error_codes.POWER_OFF: The ambient light must be powered on.
error_codes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Color must use the 24-bit sRGB hexadecimal format #RRGGBB.

get_effect.name: get_effect
get_effect.description: Return the selected dynamic lighting effect. Requires the ambient light to be powered on.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.effect: Selected dynamic effect: pulse, wave, or rainbow. (type=string)

error_codes.POWER_OFF: The ambient light must be powered on.

set_effect.name: set_effect
set_effect.description: Select the pulse, wave, or rainbow dynamic lighting effect. Selection does not start a stopped effect; if an effect is already running, the newly selected effect becomes active immediately. Requires the ambient light to be powered on. Invalid input or a failed power precondition leaves state unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

error_codes.POWER_OFF: The ambient light must be powered on.
error_codes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Effect must be pulse, wave, or rainbow.

get_effect_state.name: get_effect_state
get_effect_state.description: Return whether the selected dynamic effect is stopped or running. Requires the ambient light to be powered on.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.effect_state: Current dynamic effect state: stopped or running. (type=string)

error_codes.POWER_OFF: The ambient light must be powered on.

start_effect.name: start_effect
start_effect.description: Start the selected dynamic lighting effect and leave static color mode. Requires the ambient light to be powered on and the effect state to be stopped. A failed precondition leaves state unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

error_codes.POWER_OFF: The ambient light must be powered on.
error_codes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: The dynamic effect is already running.

stop_effect.name: stop_effect
stop_effect.description: Stop the running dynamic lighting effect and return to the inherited static color mode. Requires the ambient light to be powered on and the effect state to be running. The selected effect is preserved for a later start. A failed precondition leaves state unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

error_codes.POWER_OFF: The ambient light must be powered on.
error_codes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: No dynamic effect is running.
